Since early stage of diagnosis may be helpful in reducing the severity of the disease. This study has a significant concern in deciding the suitable Machine Learning (ML) algorithm that suits best for analyzing CKD based on the accuracy rate. The demonstration work is performed with the commonly utilized machine learning classifiers. As a result of the demonstration work, it is revealed that J48 algorithm has higher rate of accuracy than other conventional machine learning techniques.

articleTitle: TizenRT OS Based Data Compression Algorithms for IoT Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: The paper investigates the integration and adaptation of the LZ4 compression algorithm within the context of TizenRT, in addition to existing algorithms Miniz and LZMA. TizenRT, a real-time operating system tailored for Internet of Things (IoT) devices, presents unique challenges in balancing compression efficiency and resource constraints. The study evaluates the performance of LZ4 alongside Miniz and LZMA in terms of compression ratios, processing overhead, and memory utilization. Experimental results demonstrate the feasibility of LZ4's adoption in TizenRT, highlighting its potential to enhance data compression and decompression operations while adhering to the stringent requirements of IoT devices. The findings contribute to the optimization of data management strategies within the TizenRT ecosystem.

articleTitle: Image Captioning for Chest X-Rays Using GRU - Based Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: Medical image captioning is a field that combines medical imaging with natural language processing (NLP). Since the development of deep learning techniques in both NLP and medical image analysis, this area of study has gained significant progress. This research aims to develop a system for providing a brief description when given an image of chest x-ray using a GRU-based Attention Model, which gave better training and validation accuracy and BLEU scores when compared to a simple encoder-decoder, attention mechanism implemented with context flow and global flow and other state-of-the-art models using chexnet. The Chest X-Ray Images dataset, consisting of a large number of images of different chest x-rays suffering from pneumonia with different points of view (anterior-posterior), is utilized for training and validation of the model. The proposed model is trained using a combination of chest x-ray images along with their text features. The findings demonstrate the potential of using the GRU-based attention model for detection and classification of pneumonia, which can be applied for diagnosis in hospitals, clinics, emergency departments and screening programs.

articleTitle: A New Unsupervised Feature Extraction Method for Fault Diagnosis of Machines
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: In order to accurately predict the current health condition of rotating machinery tools, multiple sensors are mounted on rotating machines to capture diverse fault signals. These raw signals are then subjected to statistical feature extraction to predict the bearing's health condition. However, variations in the information of collected sensor signals occur due to sensor placement and structural/environmental noises that potentially lead to inconsistent prediction results. To address this problem, a novel method for extracting features from multisensor data is proposed. In the proposed method, first, spectrogram-based features have been extracted from different sensor data. Correlated features are then extraced from these features using the deep canonical correlation model. Further, feature pooling has been performed to get discriminative features. Finally, pooled feature vectors are used to train the convolutional neural network to recognize the health state of the machine. The PRONOSTIA degradation-bearing datasets are used to validate the proposed methodology. The datasets contain vibration data that has been collected across varying running speeds and loads. The proposed approach has also been tested under noisy and imbalanced conditions. We demonstrate that our method can effectively recognize the machine's fault conditions.

articleTitle: Blending Forest with Neural Networks: An Insight into Marula Leaf Disease Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: The economic value of Marula trees is investigated here by looking at the impact of disease on fruit production. The prediction of eight major Marula diseases is made possible with the introduction of a novel technology that combines Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Random Forests. This model incorporates the feature-extracting power of a CNN with the robustness of a Random Forests ensemble. It uses four ReLU-activated convolutional layers and a max-pooling layer to process the data, which consists of photos of both healthy and diseased Marula leaves. These features are fed into Random Forest, which uses them to make diagnoses. The model's strong predictive capacity is demonstrated by evaluation measures showing precision and recall rates between 88.65% and 94.92%. Overall accuracy is 98%, and the Fl-Score indicates a well-balanced performance from the model. Metrics like “Macro Average” show how much better the model performs than other approaches. The study demonstrates the potential of combining deep and ensemble learning for disease prediction, and hence makes a substantial contribution to agricultural disease management. It lays the groundwork for the sustainable production of Marula and highlights the broader implications for global food security and future agricultural innovation based on machine learning.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Human Resource Management and Market Research for Enhanced Effectiveness and Organizational Benefits
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: This study investigates the substantial implications of cutting-edge technology on forecasting market demand, improving safety, and human resource management (HRM). The study simplifies the candidate selection method by applying Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) models to automate application screening. The use of Arduino micro controllers in conjunction with temperature, fire, and smoke sensors increases real-time reactions to potential dangers for improving safety in resource management. Artificial neural networks (ANN) are used to forecast market demand based on data from automotive sales from 2016 to 2023. The outcomes demonstrate how effective each technique was. LSTM-driven applicant screening demonstrates the capacity to boost HRM by accelerating the recruiting process. The integration of Arduino controllers demonstrates rapid and precise risk recognition, enhancing industrial safety. When it comes to forecasting automotive sales for 2022, the ANN model, in particular, predicts market demand with astonishing precision, achieving a 100<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> accuracy rate. This implies that it is capable of strategic planning and resource management. These findings underscore the critical role that AI-driven systems play in improving organisational performance, security, and decision-making, as well as the revolutionary potential of AI -driven systems across a wide range of industries. By acting as a sobering reminder of the dynamic interplay that happens between industry and technology, the research lays the path for a more safe and successful future.

articleTitle: Agricultural Innovation: Unleashing Federated Learning CNNs on Coffee Leaf Disease Severity Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: This study adopts a novel strategy using federated learning with a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to identify and categorize Cucurbit leaf diseases. The research includes information from six customers, each with access to distinctive, local datasets of Cucurbit leaf illnesses divided into four severity categories, ranging from 1% to 25% to 50% to 75% to 100%. The use of federated averaging, which combines local model updates into a global one, is a crucial component of this work. This approach highlights a significant development in machine learning by using dispersed data without data centralization. The findings show that the model performed well, with accuracy, recall, and Fl-scores ranging from 85.93% to 94.85% across all customers, illuminating the model's strength and adaptability. The performance of the client model Cltt-3 was outstanding, with measures averaging a startling 95%. Additionally, findings from macro, micro, and weighted averages were similarly exceptional, demonstrating the model's adaptability to various class distributions and severity levels. In summary, this work shows the impressive effectiveness of federated learning with CNN in combating Cucurbit leaf diseases and sketches out possible application scenarios. The reliable findings confirm the efficacy of federated learning in a decentralized data environment while opening up fresh opportunities for the global model to be improved using lessons from local datasets.

articleTitle: Enhancing Digital Investigation: Leveraging ChatGPT for Evidence Identification and Analysis in Digital Forensics
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: The potential value of ChatGPT, more specifically GPT 3.5 and GPT 4, is assessed in locating evidence for digital investigation. Investigators can benefit from ChatGPT as a tool. With the help of ChatGPT, various evidence identification tasks, including evidence evaluation, interpretation of the language, conceptual comprehension, phrase and word extraction, criminal examination of communication patterns can be analysed. The research highlights how AI models can process enormous volumes of data, improving investigators speed and accuracy. Furthermore, it examines the advantages and consequences of employing ChatGPT and other artificial intelligence (AI) tools to find evidence, including the potential for efficiency and scalability. The findings shed light on ChatGPT's game-changing potential in the realm of digital forensics and offer suggestions for its responsible future growth. To ascertain the efficacy and efficiency of AI-based methods in this area, several articles that concentrate on ChatGPT Forensics Analysis Evidence Identification (CFA-EI) framework have been evaluated and reviewed.

articleTitle: An Investigation into the Prediction of Annual Income Levels Through the Utilization of Demographic Features Employing the Modified UCI Adult Dataset
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: Predicting an individual's annual income is crucial and has many uses for the planning of government, policymakers, and development partners. This paper uses the UCI Adult Dataset to examine demographic-based annual income predictions. The 16-column dataset classifies “Income” into two categories: <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$< =50\mathrm{K}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$> 50\mathrm{K}$</tex>, where 14 characteristics provide personal information. Appropriate Methods to Handle Categorical Data guidelines govern the study's preprocessing, categorical data management, and missing value strategies. Eleven machine learning models are then studied, including classification, clustering, neural networks, Logistic Regression, Naive Bayes (standard and Gaussian), K-Nearest Neighbors, SVMs, Decision Trees, Random Forest, XGBoost, and Artificial Neural Networks. This study emphasizes optimization, evaluation, and model comparison and how optimization strategies and parameters affect model performance. Comparative analyses compare model performance within a category. The results imply that demographic characteristics help some models predict income levels better. Logistic Regression provides essential knowledge; whereas XGBoost and Neural Networks improve accuracy, Clustering adds knowledge. This study's findings inform revenue-anticipation-related decision-making with an accuracy of 87% from XGBoost and XGBoost-ANN Ensembling. This study emphasizes the need for data pretreatment, algorithm selection, optimization, and evaluation for accurate predictions and valuable insights.

articleTitle: Leveraging Blockchain Technology for Effective Healthcare Solutions: Requirements, Architecture, Applications and Recent Advances
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: Blockchain technology is a very high powered technology that encounters a vast variety of features. For cloud-edge systems to do data integrity audits blockchain is an authentic tool. Using blockchain hospitals can become nodes to put up distributed ledger that make sure the combat collusion and tamper resistance. It emphasize the role of blockchain in ensuring data integrity, managing access, data security and privacy based on the context of healthcare. Patient histories, healthcare management, efficient data records, access to healthcare datasets that are facilitates by blockchain in the healthcare sector. This paper examines the relation between healthcare sector and blockchain technology that shows features and recent advances. This paper concludes the major role of blockchain in the healthcare sector in developing a well-organized and secured health records.

articleTitle: Empowering Healthcare Systems Using Machine Learning: Working, Classification and Application
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: Empowering Healthcare Systems with Machine Learning: Mechanisms, Classifications, and Applications' examines how machine learning (ML) and healthcare are dynamically combining. It explains how ML algorithms manage healthcare data in detail, classifies ML's many healthcare applications, and emphasizes the significant impact of these applications. ML transforms healthcare systems, improving everything from the accuracy of disease diagnosis to the creation of individualized treatment approaches. To ensure appropriate integration, ethical and legal aspects are emphasized. In addition to redefining patient care, this ML and healthcare synergy improves decision-making and improves patient outcomes. The paper's main contribution is its discussion of an overview of machine learning (ML), which includes its needs, features, many applications and challenges and difficulty of (ML) in health sector. This paper highlights how (ML) have the ability to improve healthcare efficiency in general and the diagnosis and personalization of patient care. But it also acknowledges problems like data accessibility, data quality, high dimensionality, efficiency, and privacy issues that demand careful thought.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Hybrid Deep Learning Techniques for COVID-19 Detection based on Cough Sound Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic, produced by the SARS-CoV-2 virus, has severe global consequences, resulting in substantial loss of life and posing a serious threat globally. Cough is a common sign and consequence of COVID-19. Cough sound analysis has the ability to help determine an individual's COVID-19 status. Using deep learning models, this study aims to improve the accuracy of COVID-19 identification based on cough sounds. The work employs twelve separate deep-learning models that were extensively trained on the COUGHVID dataset such as CNN, LSTM, BiLSTM, CNN-LSTM, CNN-BiLSTM with SGD, and Adamax optimizer, Attention-based CNN-LSTM with Adamax, SGD and RMSProp optimizer, Attention-based CNN-BiLSTM Adamax, SGD and RMSProp optimizer. To overcome class imbalance, procedures such as pitch shifting and time-frequency masking are used to increase the positive class. Among these variants, the integration of an attention mechanism model with a convolutional neural network (CNN), a bidirectional long short-term memory (Bi-LSTM) with Adamax optimizer achieved the highest validation accuracy, reaching 95.34%, precision 94.40 %, recall 95.50%, Fl-score 94.44%.

articleTitle: An Efficient and Robust Facial Image Encryption Algorithm for Biometric Identity Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: In comparison to alternative identification methods such as graphical-based passwords, textual-based passwords, and email verification, biometric authentication systems provide improved convenience and security for accessing information systems. Nevertheless, biometric-based systems, including facial recognition, are at risk of tampering attacks on their databases. To guarantee the security of stored facial images and counteract tampering database attacks, it is essential to implement a robust encryption scheme specifically designed for facial images. Through the implementation of encryption, the images become impervious to alterations by unauthorized individuals who may gain access to the storage infrastructure. This research paper introduces a robust facial image encryption algorithm specifically created to tackle database tampering attacks. The algorithm has been developed with the purpose of seamlessly integrating it into facial authentication systems. The suggested encryption technique uses the Henon map to shuffle the pixels and applies class-3 one-dimensional cellular automata rules for pixel substitution. The security analysis and experimental findings demonstrate that the proposed method offers an extensive key space and robustly withstands various attacks. The encrypted image shows a minimal correlation between adjacent pixels, indicating high effectiveness.

articleTitle: Enhancing Industrial Load Scheduling through Demand Side Management and Advanced Optimization Techniques Using Neuro-Fuzzy and Deep Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: This study aims to investigate whether physical factors like temperature, humidity, and pressure interact with current in Micro-electromechanical systems (MEMS). To study these interactions, a straightforward system with four spin-operated engines was employed. The pressure, humidity, and temperature may all change as a result of changing the motor's output current. The results are evaluated and predicted using LSTM and Neuro-Fuzzy models. Sensors are used to keep an eye on these circumstances. Neurofuzzy models employ fuzzy logic and artificial intelligence to capture interconnections, as opposed to LSTM models, which use their capacity to comprehend data connections to capture long-term effects. The results demonstrate that the body's capacity to exert energy is enhanced by the effect of body energy on temperature, humidity, and pressure. The research could lead to improvements in temperature control, energy efficiency, and the functionality and design of massive industrial machinery. A straightforward design is used to launch controlled experiments, and the data collected is then used to train and assess the model. By offering helpful suggestions for the improvement of the motor and the operating electric economy, this study contributes to our understanding of the evolution of the electric motor.

articleTitle: A Novel Reinforcement Learning Based Optimization Approach for Supply Chain Management
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: In this research, a method for improving supply chain management transport routing decisions is developed. It made use of reinforcement learning, more especially the Advan-tage Actor-Critic (A2C) model. The A2C approach integrated value-based and policy-based learning to successfully handle the dynamic and unpredictable nature of transport routing difficulties. The A2C model could choose the best route, allocate the load, and schedule by learning from previous experiences. The goal of this research to create a simulation environment that fully accounted for the complexities of transport routing in supply chain networks, taking into account variables like traffic conditions, delivery deadlines, vehicle capacities, and resource availability. In order to increase the efficacy and efficiency of transport routing decisions, the A2C model was trained in this context. To assess the effectiveness of the A2C model in achieving optimal transport routing solutions, a thorough performance study and comparison with baseline techniques were performed. The findings and understandings from this study advanced the subject of supply chain management and gave organizations looking to improve their transport routing plans invaluable advice.

articleTitle: Psychological Restrain for Fault Detection in Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: Reinforcement learning is a sub part of machine learning that aims for adapting its agent or agents to the unfeasible environment with a solo purpose of achieving the maximum rewards. In common RL agents are trained to find the optimum policy for the varied actions and to achieve the maximum rewards possible. Markov Decision processes that call a rule of penalty if and only if it got the penalty or transit to achieve the penalty. But however, getting all the data set values that shows all those transit states or chances where it couldn't be able to get the rewards. In this paper, we put forward the Reinforcement Learning psychological restrain for fault detection that will visualize the restrains that block the agent to optimize the rewards. These bugs can be in the logical part of the code or there might be a misplaced value of rewards or penalty that got missed by the programmer. Its effectiveness can be shown via snake game.

Author Keywords: Psychological Restrain For Fault Detection in Reinforcement Learning (PRFDRL)

articleTitle: Modelling the Domains of Artificial Intelligence on Social Good: A Study on Analytic-Based Hierarchy
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: AI is the technology that has transformed many industries and various sectors which include healthcare, finance education, agriculture etc. The purpose of this study is to explore the impact of AI on social good. More specifically, this research prioritizes the domains and subdomains of AI. Initially, the literature has been extensively reviewed to identify the uncharted implications of AI. To conduct the study authors have adopted the secondary research and a theoretical model has been developed to prioritize the domains at the time of contingency; for that purpose, an Analytical Hierarchical Process, a tool of MCDM, is used. The findings of the study concluded with a theoretical model presenting the rankings and maximum global weights. The current study has been conducted in the Indian context. Therefore, this can be considered as a limitation of research. Current study significantly contributes to the body of literature in this field and presents a hierarchical model of artificial intelligence domains and sub domains impacting social good.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Model for 3D LiDAR Point Cloud Codec Based on Tensor
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: In recent years, deep learning techniques, especially autoencoders, have shown remarkable ability in learning compact and meaningful representations from raw point cloud data. In this paper, new approach is proposed to enhance the performance of autoencoders for 3D point cloud data by integrating tensor-based methods. By exploiting the inherent multidimensional nature of point cloud data, the proposed method uses tensor to capture complex spatial relationships and feature interactions. A special architecture is designed to effectively use tensor-based operations and allow networks to learn hierarchical representations of point cloud data. The approach includes two techniques: tensor compression and deep feature learning. The tensor compression phase uses state-of-the-art tensor decomposition algorithm to exploit the inherent redundancies and patterns within the 3D point cloud data. By converting the raw point cloud data into a compressed tensor format, it significantly reduces 39.94% which is 5:3 compressed form of 3D point cloud into its dimensionality while preserving important spatial relationships between points. This compression not only speeds up subsequent processing steps, but also makes the data easier to store and transfer. Compressed tensor representations serve as inputs to deep learning models specifically designed to extract salient features and meaningful representations from compressed data. It uses a multimodal neural network architecture with convolutional and iterative layers to capture both local and global patterns in point cloud data. The findings of the experiment show the superiority of the methodology in terms of both reconstruction accuracy and feature extraction compared with existing techniques. A proposed deep learning model based on Tensor (DLBT) is a Lossless compression method provides a solution for efficient data storage, transmission, and processing in 3D LiDAR applications.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Techniques for the Prediction of Cyber-Attacks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: The aim of this paper to develop a machine-learning (ML) model for UNSW-NBI5 dataset cyberattack prediction. ML is a subset of AI which is a powerful tool for detection of the cyber-attacks. It uses existing data to identify the same pattern between old attacks and new attacks. ML helps to identify the features and characteristics of cyber-attacks. This paper employed four different classifiers: Random Forest (RF), Decision Tree (DT), Logistic Regression (LR), and ANN (Artificial Neural Network) on the UNSW-NB15 dataset. 9-fold cross-validation is used on the dataset to determine each classifier's best accuracy. For Ann, we used four layers which are the input layer, two hidden layers, and the output layer. In the input layer, we used 10 neurons. In the first hidden layer, we used 15 neurons, and 10 neurons for second layer. 1 neuron is used in the output layer. The classifiers are evaluated on the basis of accuracy, precision, recall, fl-score, mean square error(MSE), true positive rate (TPR), and false positive rate (FPR). Among all of the classifiers, RF overpowered other models and gave an accuracy of 0.95167% with a TPR of 0.96252% and a FPR of 0.06749%.

articleTitle: Assessing the Impact of Financial Inclusion Efficiency on the Sustainable Development Goals
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: This research paper's main goal is to examine how India's Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) are impacted by financial inclusion efficiency (FIE). These effects are assessed by the study using a single model. To determine how effectively financial inclusion is working, the Data Envelopment Approach (DEA) is used as the methodology. The deployment of automated teller machines (ATMs) and the number of commercial banks with functioning offices in each state serve as the inputs and outputs of this approach, respectively, while the state-level deposits and bank credit offered by scheduled commercial banks are the inputs. Efficiency is computed by dividing the inputs by the outputs for each state. The dataset used in this paper contains information about the 28 states and three union territories of India from 2018 to 2020. The study results show a negative relationship between FIE and SDG. The study differentiates itself from the previous studies in that it is being done on a Pan-Indian basis, not restricted to certain states or states. Unlike the earlier studies, the paper's current findings suggest a need for rechecking the fact that fie initiatives negatively impact SDG.

articleTitle: AI Driven Sentiment Analysis for Social Media Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: Sentiment analysis (SA) is a subject of ongoing text mining research. The subjectivity, emotions, and viewpoints of a text are handled algorithmically by sentiment analysis. This survey research examines the most recent development in this field in great detail. This paper examines and provides a quick overview of various recently suggested algorithm enhancements. Based on their contributions to the various sentiment analysis approaches, these articles are categorized into various categories. Sentiment analysis may be utilised to extract information related to thoughts and feelings from human-generated textual data. Users have posted a significant quantity of unprocessed material to social networking sites in the shape of speech, videos, photographs, and audio. Global catastrophes including heatwaves, earthquakes, cyclones, floods and bushfires are having an extraordinary impact on social media users' life. They frequently write how pessimistic they find the catastrophic scenarios at their target area to be. Politicians and strategic planners must prioritise comprehending location-specific attitudes towards crisis situations. Data may be turned into valuable knowledge by using sentiment analysis. The primary goal of the questionnaire is to provide a concise, almost complete picture of Sentiment Analysis methods and associated topics. The comprehensive categories of several recently published papers and the explanation of the present state of research in sentiment evaluation as well as related fields are the key contributions made by this study.

articleTitle: Ocular Artefact Removal from Electroencephalogram Signals: A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: Electroencephalogram (EEG) is widely utilized since it provides information on brain activity without causing any harm to the subject. EEG's great sensitivity makes it vulnerable to artefacts from both the environment and the brain. Blinks and eye movement, head movement, pulse, and so on may all generate artefacts in EEG recordings, which is the primary source of poor signal quality. Artefacts complicate the analysis of EEG data and may lead to erroneous conclusions about brain activity because they overlap with the signal collected from the brain. The creation of algorithms to detect and eliminate artefacts from EEG signals is crucial for obtaining such precise and trustworthy signal information. In this study, we take a look at the state of the art in removing artefacts caused by blinks and eye movements from EEG data. However, conventional artefact removal methods cannot eradicate all noise and will result in data loss due to the indiscriminate elimination of contaminated parts. The research demonstrates that combining conventional with other approaches is widely utilized because it may enhance artefact removal. The most up-to-date method for eliminating artefacts is an automated one that uses machine learning and deep neural networks.

articleTitle: An Investigation on Internet of Things: Smart Grid Technology Framework's
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: The traditional grid networks could be upgraded to smart grids via Internet of Things (IoT) technology. This paper discusses the various grid system architecture's, technologies, and latest communication protocols for the IoT enabled smart grids. Literature survey shows that the technological advancements in power systems are making the grids better in terms of stability and sustainability; but one of the major issue related to such advancements, especially in the IoT enabled smart grids is related to data theft. This paper summarizes the IoT enabled mitigation techniques for such smart grid system vulnerabilities. Use of technologies such as bigdata, machine learning, augmented reality and blockchain, can give support to the IoT smart energy systems so that it become more flexible, safe, and secure. This paper summarizes the knowledge of such advanced technologies which are indeed helpful to make the IoT enabled smart grid system more effective technically, economically, and socially.

articleTitle: Convergence to Nash Equilibrium: A Comparative Study of Rock-Paper-Scissors Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: Rock-paper-scissors is one of the most established imperfect information games in Game theory. The Nash Equilibrium of an RPS game is relatively simple but computationally intractable; hence, various algorithms are employed to converge to a state of maximum payoff. In this paper, five algorithms, namely - Counterfactual Regret Minimization, Monte Carlo Tree Search, Q-Iearning, Deep Q-Network and Proximal Policy Optimization, have been compared on the evaluation metrics of average reward, draw ratio and convergence speed. Throughout the comparative analysis, visualising the learning curves, and qualitative comparison, Q-Iearning has shown the best convergence to Nash equilibrium for RPS.

articleTitle: Predicting Customer Satisfaction in Brazil E-commerce: A Comparative Study of Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: Customers' propensity for brand loyalty, recurrent business, and positive word-of-mouth are directly influenced by the degree to which their needs are met. E-commerce happens to be one of the biggest online industries in the world which till date is not completely understood from a customer's standpoint. Brazil being a developing country is the 12<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> largest market for e-commerce in the world and accounts for 30 % of e-commerce in Latin America and remains largely unexplored. In this study, we used machine learning (ML) techniques such as LSTM, XGBClassifier, Logistic Regression, Neural Network, and Random Forest to predict customer satisfaction using a retail dataset from Brazil. We contrasted the efficacy of these models using a variety of evaluation criteria, such as precision, recall, and Fl-score. The LSTM model had the highest accuracy with a score of 0.89, followed by the XGBClassifier with 0.83, Naive Bayes with 0.73, Logistic Regression with 0.74, Support Vector Classifier with 0.74, and Random Forest with 0.78. The superior performance of the LSTM model over other models suggests that it has superior predictive abilities.

articleTitle: Enabling Intelligent Decision Making: Harnessing Advanced Management Strategies for Enhanced Organizational Efficiency and Effectiveness
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: In today's dynamic and complex business landscape, effective management and decision-making are crucial for organizations to thrive and adapt. The integration of intelligent technologies has revolutionized traditional management practices by offering data-driven insights and automated solutions. This research paper explores the intersection of Intelligent Management and Decision Making, delving into the symbiotic relationship between advanced technologies and strategic decision processes. We examine how artificial intelligence, machine learning, big data analytics, and predictive modeling contribute to informed decision-making across various industries. Drawing from real-world case studies and empirical research, we analyze the benefits and challenges associated with adopting intelligent management systems. Furthermore, we discuss the ethical considerations entailed in entrusting critical decisions to automated systems. By synthesizing theoretical frameworks and practical applications, this paper provides valuable insights for organizational leaders, researchers, and practitioners seeking to navigate the evolving landscape of Intelligent management and decision-making,

articleTitle: Tales of the Rosehip: A Journey Through Neural Networks and Whispering Forests
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: Infectious plant diseases are a major hindrance to agricultural output and viability. Effective disease management relies on correct and prompt disease diagnosis. For the purpose of multi-class categorization of six frequent diseases affecting rosehip leaves, the authors of this study propose a hybrid model that incorporates Convolutional Neural Networks and Random Forests. There are four convolutional layers, one max-pooling layer, and then a Random Forest classifier in the model's architecture. Rosehip leaf photos were annotated with information about six different diseases (Diplocarpon rosae, Podosphaera pannosa, Phragmidium, Rose Mosaic Disease, Cercospora rosicola, and Rose Rosette Disease; RRD) to assess the model's accuracy. The model performed exceptionally well, with high precision, recall, and F1 scores for every disease category. Micro and macro average scores both showed that the model could correctly detect diseases with a 99% success rate. Their results corroborate the usefulness of a hybrid strategy, in which the CNN extracts useful characteristics from the input photos and the Random Forest classifier makes good use of them to accurately categorize diseases. The model's promising results suggest it might be used in real-world settings, such as precision agriculture and automated plant disease diagnosis. The successful application of the suggested hybrid model to the identification of rosehip leaf diseases advances the creation of novel and dependable disease detection methods for agricultural systems. This study demonstrates the potential of merging deep learning and ensemble learning methods, providing a useful resource for farmers and agronomists working to improve disease management strategies and maintain rosehip plants' health and productivity.

articleTitle: AES Encryption for Secure Storage and Transfer of Patient Health Records using Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: The thesis emphasises the critical role that cryptography-more especially, AES and DES encryption-plays in protecting private communications transmitted over wireless channels, especially when it comes to safely preserving patient health records. The suggested solution uses a blockchain network and AES/DES encryption to guarantee data transformation traceability and foster patient and healthcare provider trust. It deals with problems with centralised Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems, which may lead to fragmented medical records across multiple organisations and serve as a single point of failure, which could lead to incorrect diagnoses. The primary thesis is to develop a blockchain-based system for the safe trading and storing of vital health assets. It describes the characteristics, benefits, and uses of encryption methods, with a focus on the AES and DES algorithms' use for secure server and user communication.

articleTitle: Analysis of Different Variants of Relief Based Algorithms for Feature Selection in Medical Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: This research paper explores the efficacy of Relief-based algorithms (RBAs) in the domain of medical data analysis, with a specific focus on lung cancer classification. Faced with the growing complexity of biological data and the need for computationally efficient yet sophisticated feature selection methods, RBAs emerge as a compelling solution. Various RBA variants, including ReliefF, Iterative Relief, I-Relief, SURF and MultiSURF, offer distinct perspectives on feature weighting and selection. Empirical analysis on lung cancer datasets reveals notable results, highlighting the impressive 0.80 accuracy rate achieved by I-Relief in classification tasks, thus confirming its effectiveness. These findings contribute to a deeper understanding of RBA capabilities and provide valuable insights for their future application and refinement within the domain of medical data analysis.

articleTitle: Boundary-based X-Ray Lung Segmentation: A Novel Approach for Improving Accuracy and Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: Lung image segmentation plays a crucial role in medical diagnostics and treatment planning. This research paper addresses the challenge of accurately segmenting lung images from X-rays using a novel approach that combines semantic boundary-based segmentation and the alpha-shape algorithm. Additionally, the global mask concept is introduced to impose constraints on the shape of the output. The proposed method is evaluated against a semantic segmentation approach with full-mask utilization. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach outperforms the baseline method, yielding significant improvements in segmentation quality. The proposed technique achieves a 4% improvement in the Jaccard metric and a 2% improvement in the Dice metric. These findings highlight the effectiveness of our approach, particularly when the objects to be segmented exhibits similar shape patterns.

articleTitle: Recent Advancements in Image Forgery Detection Techniques: A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: The instantaneous developments in professional image editing tools have made it easier for mischievous individuals to make alterations to digital images and use them for inappropriate purposes, leading to a growth in concern of the reliability of the visual content. The consequences extend to affecting various aspects of life including legal proceeding, journalism and even to a personal level. This review paper emphasizes on surveying multiple image forgery techniques for images that have undergone multiple image transformations; passive and active detection techniques in particular. When of traditional image forgery is combines with higher level image transformation (such as geometric transformation), it conceals and complicates the alterations made to a digital image. This is carried out by applying certain proficient modifications like rotations, resizing, scaling etc. The researchers have carried out a depth-analysis of the image forgery detection techniques as well as its sub-types, already existing algorithms and methods, describing them hereby aiming to provide the details, analysis, advantages, limitations and the potential opportunities for future work. As a result, contributing to a better understanding of the forgery detection techniques to preserve the authenticity of an image.

articleTitle: An Empirical and Statistical Analysis of Regression Algorithms Used for Mental Fitness Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: In today's focus on mental well-being, technology's capability to predict and comprehend mental fitness holds substantial significance. This study delves into the relationship between mental health indicators and mental fitness levels through diverse machine learning algorithms. Drawing from a vast dataset spanning countries and years, the research unveils concealed patterns shaping mental well-being. Precise analysis of key mental health conditions reveals their prevalence and interactions across demographics. Enriched by insights into Disability-Adjusted Life Years (DALYs), the dataset offers a comprehensive view of mental health's broader impact. Through rigorous comparative analysis, algorithms like Linear Regression, Random Forest, Support Vector Regression, Gradient Boosting, K-nearest neighbors and Theil Sen Regression are assessed for predictive accuracy. Mean squared error (MSE), root mean squared error (RMSE), and Rsquared (R2) scores are used to assess the predictive accuracy of each algorithm. Results show that Mean Squared Error (MSE) ranged from 0.030 to 1.277, Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) from 0.236 to 1.130, and R-squared (R2) scores ranged between 0.734 and 0.993, with Random Forest Regressor achieving the highest accuracy. This study offers precise prognostications regarding mental fitness and establishes the underpinnings for the creation of effective tracking tools. Amidst society's endeavor to tackle intricate issues surrounding mental health, our research facilitates well-informed interventions and individualized strategies. This underscores the noteworthy contribution of technology in shaping a more Invigorating trajectory for the future.

articleTitle: Enhancing Secure Video Transmission and Cloud-Based Storage through Advanced Encryption, Hashing, and Distributed Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: It is critical in today's data-centric world to ensure the privacy and security of video data preserved in the cloud. This investigation looks at the issues of securing video data in cloud environments, where privacy and security are top priorities. The use of a hybrid cryptosystem that incorporates symmetric and asymmetric encryption algorithms is proposed as an innovative approach. This cutting-edge technology enhances the security, integrity, and availability of video data while decreasing the processing resources required for encryption and decryption operations. The study offers actual evidence demonstrating the feasibility and efficacy of the suggested technique by demonstrating improvements in data security, performance, and scalability. This analysis not only enhances data security but also the efficacy of cloud-based video management. This technique's ramifications for the future of video encryption and cloud computing research are also highlighted.

articleTitle: Dermcare - Skin Disease Classification from Image
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: Being one of the most exposed organs, the human skin acts as the body's main line of protection against microbiological dangers. Nevertheless, systematic approaches to product utilization and skincare regimens are still largely unexplored. Due to the variety and dynamic nature of skin illnesses, as well as their rising frequency among skin types from different cultural backgrounds, effective methods of diagnosis and treatment are required. The current system for diagnosing skin diseases is complicated and mainly depends on expert medical opinion and information from skin biopsies. Objective: The goal of the study is to increase the accuracy of diagnosis while overcoming the difficulties in differentiating between skin disorders that appear physically identical. By lowering diagnosis time and encouraging more practical and accurate treatment options, this method aims to improve patient care. Methodology: The classification model for skin diseases will be created using a convolutional neural network. The preprocessed picture dataset will be used to train the newly created CNN model. The model's parameters will need to be optimized during the training process. A separate validation dataset will be used to test the trained model's effectiveness in correctly categorizing various skin conditions. Results: The proposed deep learning-based skin disease classification system demonstrated promising results in accurately diagnosing various skin conditions. The model achieved an overall accuracy of 91 % on the validation dataset, indicating its effectiveness in distinguishing between different diseases.

articleTitle: A Study on User Technology Readiness in the Context of E-Banking Lounge Service
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: The primary objective of this research is to utilize smart delivery platforms' technical capabilities to identify homogeneous groups of banking customers in North India, considering their traits related to optimism, innovativeness, discomfort, and insecurity with technology-based banking services. By employing the K-means cluster analysis with the Euclidean distance algorithm, the study processed data from 1050 clients with access to self-service e-banking lounges, resulting in the formation of three distinct user clusters: pioneers, explorers, and laggards. Notably, the majority of users were classified as explorers, followed by pioneers and laggards. Age played a significant role, with older customers demonstrating resistance to automation, while younger age groups showed more inclination and demand for technological solutions. Surprisingly, technologically savvy individuals expressed higher satisfaction with automated services compared to their less tech-savvy counterparts. Intriguingly, customer experience did not directly influence cluster formation for the e-banking lounge. This innovative study represents the first attempt at utilizing cluster analysis to identify potential e-banking lounge customer segments based on technology readiness characteristics. The resulting market segmentation insights hold immense potential for creating targeted marketing plans and strategies within the banking sector, effectively leveraging the power of smart delivery platforms.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Survey on Production of Fabric from the Organic Extract
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: The application of varied/various fabric types is constantly on the rise over time, the process of the fabric making involves a lot of fabric offcuts. The textile industry domain consists of transformation of fiber to yarn, yarn to fabric and fabric to finished garments. During these processes, the waste is generated in a large quantity and evidences from past justify the fact that fashion industry is lacking in sustainability measures. The textile industries create environmental harm at all stages of production from raw material cultivation to disposal of finished goods. Large amount of chemical loads, high amount of water usage, high energy consumption, air emission, solid waste are major environmental challenges in textile industries. This review paper will provide a comprehensive and up-to-date overview of sustainable fabrics, offering insights into their environmental, social and economic benefits. By understanding the potential of these alternatives, we can collectively contribute to a more sustainable and responsible fashion industry, fostering a healthier planet for future generations. An comprehensive range of fabric has been explored, each renowned by unique set of qualities. Sustainable fabrics such as bamboo, banana, coffee, hemp are examined that have beneficial outcomes unlike synthetic/polyster fabrics. The transition to such sustainable fabrics is a necessity. The sustainable fabrics are decent and renewable, these can unlock a new opportunity towards a eco-friendlier alternative. Dyeing also causes negative impacts which can be resolved by using sustainable dye that provide natural color and environmental benefits. In concordant, these sustainable methods and alternatives should be employed to foster better and sustainable world.

articleTitle: Sustainable Coffee Production: A Federated Learning Framework with CNN for Disease Detection and Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: Using federated learning with Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), this research study provides a novel technique for identifying and categorizing coffee leaf illnesses. The research focuses on five categories of coffee leaf diseases and includes information from five clients, combining local knowledge with global comprehension. The research uses three averaging techniques-Macro, Micro, and Weighted averages-in the Result Analysis section, each offering significant insights into the illness categorization. Precision was 83.53%, recall was 87.04%, F1-score was 91.23%, Support was 90.46%, and accuracy was 92.79%, according to the study of the macro Average. A precision of 85.73%, recall of 88.10%, F1-score of 91.74%, Support of 90.62%, and accuracy of 92.79% were obtained from the weighted Average. The Micro average's final statistics were accuracy at 92.78%, recall at 88.12%, F1-score at 91.73%, and Support at 90.62%. Additionally, federated averaging, a technique that harmonizes local data and transforms it into useful global insights, was used in the research's part on converting local data to global data. The values for the five clients were Cta-1: 83.69% precision, 83.41 % recall, 83.49% F1-score, 430.40 support, and 0.94 accuracy; Cta-2: 87.18%, 86.90%, 87.03%, 518.40, and 0.95; Cta-3: 91.30%, 91.16%, 91.21 %, 638.60, and 0.97; Cta-4: 90.68%, 90.25%, 90.44%, 757.00, and 0.96; Cta-5: 92.85%, 92.74%, 92.78%, 949.80, and 0.97. This research pioneers a unique approach to disease identification in coffee leaves by the synergistic use of various approaches, possibly revolutionizing agricultural practices and resulting in more sustainable, data-driven choices in the coffee sector.

articleTitle: Pneumonia Detection Using Hybrid CNN Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: This medical research introduces a hybrid model using transfer learning from DenseNet201, InceptionResNetV2, and ResNet50 for superior pneumonia detection. Emphasizing the crucial value of early identification, we combine features from these architectures to enhance accuracy. Rigorous experiments on a sizable chest X-ray dataset showcase our model's superiority, achieving 95.67% accuracy, surpassing individual architectures and conventional methods. The model's improved generalization to new cases is attributed to the synergy of transfer learning and diverse architectures. Furthermore, we explore the interpretability of predictions for potential clinical insights. By leveraging these advanced techniques, our project contributes to more effective early-stage pneumonia detection, promising better health care outcomes.

articleTitle: Hypothesis Problem Solving Using Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: Getting answers to the questions about hypotheses can be difficult because it requires careful consideration to determine which data are essential for analysis and which hypothesis tests should be used. Obtaining relevant data can be time-consuming and calls for expertise in the relevant domain, whereas selecting the appropriate test is dependent on understanding the problem statement and the context in which it exists. These complexities frequently result in errors, delays, and inefficiencies in the decision-making process, which impedes the efficient problem-solving of hypothesis-based issues. The power of natural language processing (NLP) and various keyword detection techniques is leveraged by our proposed solution so that it can successfully overcome these challenges. Our system automates the extraction of crucial information, identifies the necessary data for analysis, and suggests the most suitable hypothesis test by applying NLP algorithms to problem statements. This automated method simplifies the process, increases accuracy, and lessens the load on the users, which enables efficient and reliable hypothesis problem-solving. Our solution improves decision-making processes and speeds up hypothesis analysis by combining natural language processing (NLP) and keyword detection, which enables more timely and accurate conclusions to be drawn. This allows our system to save time and improve accuracy to 85.7<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>.

articleTitle: Improvement in Validation Score with Loss Function for Breast Cancer Detection Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: Background: The most often type of cancer detected in women is Breast cancer. It is formed in the breast cells. It is an acutely life-threatening disease in women as compared to other cancers. Cancer caused in the breast is grouped into Various categorizations of breast cancer as per their cell's appearance (i) invasive ductal carcinoma (IDC) and (ii) ductal carcinoma in situ (DCIS), <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$2^{\mathrm{n}\mathrm{d}}$</tex> one being generally having no negative effects and is formed quite slowly, whereas the 1st one, IDC type is comparatively more dangerous and surrounds the breast tissues to great extent. Around 80% of the breast cancer patients fall under this category [1]. Scope: In the context of medical data, where comprehensive information about breast cancer and its symptoms is available, the scope of our research becomes especially relevant. This field requires efficient methods for the detection of the disease to support healthcare professionals in delivering effective diagnoses. Problem: The fundamental challenge lies in the need for timely and precise patient disease detection summaries during the diagnostic process. This problem has been a longstanding concern in the healthcare industry. The core issue at hand is the inefficiency and resource burden posed by the current manual methods of summarizing medical data during diagnosis. These methods are neither time-effective nor cost-efficient, often leading to delays in patient care and a drain on valuable resources. Overall Contribution: Our proposed method aims to Improve the validation score with loss function for breast cancer detection. This innovation will significantly benefit the research community and healthcare experts by streamlining the process of diagnosis. By saving time and resources, our contribution promises to enhance the overall efficiency of healthcare practices, leading to more effective and timely patient care.

articleTitle: DL-Based Secure Wearable Scheme for Remote Patient Data Monitoring in Healthcare 4.0
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: The paper articulates an exploration into the integration of wearable devices for remote patient data monitoring, which marks a transformative shift in healthcare practices. This transition is underscored by user-centric interfaces and applications, enabling convenient remote monitoring. However, the escalating concern of patient data vulnerability to network breaches presents a substantial impediment. In response, we introduce the proposed scheme that harnesses Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Learning (DL) techniques. The main objective of the proposed scheme is to meet the exacting requirements of healthcare systems, aiming to fortify data integrity and confidentiality. Within this context, the proposed scheme unveils a sophisticated DL-driven detection model, adeptly tailored for discerning and countering data manipulation endeavors through a nuanced multi-label classification paradigm. Notably, the emphasis lies on safeguarding patient data privacy and security, which is paramount in today's information-rich landscape. The narrative seamlessly interweaves elements of wearable technology, sensor networks, advanced DL capabilities, and robust security measures, resulting in an innovative scheme. Finally, the proposed scheme is evaluated against various metrics such as accuracy and loss curve and F1, recall, and precision comparison.

articleTitle: A review: Cattle Breed and Skin Disease Identification Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: In recent years, skin conditions have become a serious danger to livestock productivity, resulting in significant financial losses and health problems f or both humans and animals. Due to the complexity of this virus, it is difficult to detect, so early detection and accurate diagnosis are important. We thought a new approach for cattle skin disease detection, breed identification and weight estimation using image processing and deep learning techniques. The proposed system will use digital images taken from different angles of the cow's body to extract relevant features related to Lumpy skin disease, breed identification a nd weight prediction. So in this research paper we are providing a review on varieties of datasets, general architecture, different deep learning methods and performance metrics to be considered to implement such type of applications. Image processing techniques such as segmentation and texture analysis are used to isolate regions of interest and extract meaningful information about skin disease, body weight and breed. In this study further, we explore how to use Compared to conventional methods, convolutional neural networks which can detect and identify LSDV more quickly and precisely. We also considered some uses for this new technology and talked about the benefits of employing C NNs for this purpose. To determine the extent to which animals are affected by lumpy skin disease, we need to know the different stages of the disease that can be possible with the help of breed and weight identification. This review is concerned with Early diagnosis of the virus that causes lumpy skin condition, breed identification and weight prediction using multiple CNN methods and deep learning algorithms. These approaches have great potential to improve animal husbandry practices.

articleTitle: Privacy Preservation of Medical Images Using Hybrid Chaotic Maps
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: In recent times, the utilization of medical images in telemedicine applications has been experiencing significant growth in healthcare sector. After the COVID-19 pandemic, many online consultations are growing, which is convenient for old age people and time-saving compared to offline consultations. The hospitals send the patient medical reports online. The medical image determines the physical conditions of the patient. There is a chance that intruders misuse medical data for fake insurance claims. Modifying the medical report for intentional purposes undergoes false medical diagnosis. Most security breaches have occurred during the transmission of medical records. The main objective is to use a hybrid chaotic map combining Henon maps and logistic maps to improve the security of medical images. A pseudo-code number generator is utilized for secure key generation to encrypt and decrypt the image using Mersenne Twister. This proposed work has proven to conflict with statistical and differential attacks. The hybrid chaotic maps are implemented using online open-source medical image datasets, getting better results than the existing scheme. Performance of this scheme is measured using various metrics, such as histogram analysis, correlation coefficients, avalanche effect, NPCR, and UACI, to determine its effectiveness. This proposed work provides enhanced security while transmitting medical data in telemedicine applications.

articleTitle: Improving IoT Security Through Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: The swift proliferation of the Internet of Things (IoT) has escalated security apprehensions, prompting extensive research into viable solutions using established techniques and algorithms. Nevertheless, the intricacies arising from IoT limitations, such as constrained power backup and storage capacity, impede the implementation of intricate security algorithms. Addressing these challenges, Computational Intelligence emerges as a panacea. By meticulously analyzing data patterns, these techniques assess gathered information to make well-informed decisions, thereby reinforcing the security of IoT devices. Computational Intelligence encompasses several key pillars, including Artificial Neural Networks (ANN), Fuzzy Set theory, Evolutionary Computing, and Swarm Intelligence. Within this realm, Machine Learning assumes a pivotal role. This investigation primarily focuses on the utilization of. Naive Bayes, Decision Trees, Random Forest and k-Nearest Neighbors algorithms to detect potential attacks within the MQTT dataset-a well-established benchmark for IoT traffic experimentation. Notably, the simulation results underscore remarkable achievements, as all algorithms attain an impressive accuracy rate of 99%, concurrently yielding a corresponding fl-score of 99%. These findings underscore the potential of Computational Intelligence in revolutionizing IoT security, paving the way for robust protection in the ever-expanding IoT landscape.

articleTitle: Unveiling Deeper Petrochemical Insights: Navigating Contextual Question Answering with the Power of Semantic Search and LLM Fine-Tuning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: In the dynamic and complex landscape of the petrochemical industry, competitiveness and efficiency are paramount. Extracting actionable insights from diverse data sources, such as video transcripts, business process data, and organizational information, has become increasingly vital with technological advancements. Video transcripts hold untapped potential, offering opportunities to enhance products and services. This study introduces a comprehensive approach by leveraging semantic search to retrieve targeted information from video transcripts, business process data, and organizational insights. Semantic search employs natural language understanding and vectorization techniques to extract contextual information, yielding precise results and eliminating the need for manual data sifting. Comparative analysis demonstrates the superiority of semantic search over fine-tuned Large Language Models (LLMs) in relevance and response time. Semantic search consistently produces contextually relevant answers, owing to its vector-based semantic comprehension. Additionally, the response time of semantic search outperforms LLMs, enhancing user satisfaction. This research proposes the first of its kind semantic search-based approach for information retrieval in the petrochemical sector using a fusion of video transcript data with other data sources. By developing a domain-specific question answering system, the paper aims to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and decision-making. The integration of video transcripts, semantic search, and organizational data promises transformative implications for the petrochemical sector. This innovative approach holds the promise of streamlined operations, improved safety, and timely insights. The research contributes to bridging the gap in semantic search and bot-based Question Answer (QA) systems by integrating video transcript data with organizational and process data, enhancing information retrieval within the petrochemical sector.

articleTitle: Gaining Perspective into Cloud Computing: A Business-Oriented Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: Computing may be a profoundly examined subject within the technological and financial world, and numerous huge players in the software industry are working for the improvement of computing services. With the help of a literature review, this work has identified that the classification of cloud computing (CC) does not specify how to classify CC based on industry-driven professional articles, as most of this study has been based on academic distributions. This may limit the ability of the research study to provide a consolidated view of the most current advances in this topic. CC has recently captured the attention of scholars, financial professionals, and specialists. Many of these experts have proposed a variety of applications based on various cloud-based techniques, frameworks, and essentials, which have led to different interpretations, specifications, deployment models, and service models. Therefore, a complete characterization and classification of CC are needed to address the above issue. The ultimate purpose of this research is to classify CC in the literature, including the set of security concerns, history, concepts, technologies, and challenges.

articleTitle: A Multi-Category Content Classification Approach Using DistilBERT Transformer and BiLSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: The exponential growth of digital content has granted individuals unparalleled opportunities to access an extensive reservoir of knowledge. Nonetheless, the increasing presence of hazardous and explicit content inside the continuously expanding digital environment presents notable hazards to persons utilizing the internet, particularly those in younger age groups. The need of implementing effective mitigation techniques is highlighted by the potential harm that can arise from various forms of content, including text, audio, video, and pictures, which may involve violence, explicit material, and other harmful information. In order to achieve this objective, a variety of web filtering methods have been implemented to protect users, specifically minors. These methods include keyword-based filtering, Uniform Resource Locator (URL) filtering, intelligent analysis, and semantic analysis. This work presents a novel model that utilizes the combined capabilities of the DistilBERT Transformer and Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiL-STM) architecture. This model enables precise classification of website content into a maximum of ten separate categories. The aforementioned categories span a wide range of subjects, including Science and Technology, Food and Recipes, NSFW(Not Safe For Work) content, Entertainment, Politics, Business, News, Fitness and Well-being, and Blogs.

articleTitle: Resume Building Application based on LLM (Large Language Model)
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: Amid the highly competitive job market, creating an effective resume is vital but often difficult, particularly for students from underprivileged backgrounds with limited career development support. To mitigate this, we introduce a novel resume building application that employs the Large Language Model (LLM) to aid students in composing their first resumes. The application comprises three modules: Resume Generation, Resume Assessment, and User I/O. The Resume Generation module utilizes prompt engineering to produce resume bullet points, while the Resume Assessment module evaluates these bullet points for potential enhancements. The User I/O module simplifies user interaction by accepting free-style plain English as input and displaying the generated bullet points as suggestions. We have developed a prototype application that demonstrates the effectiveness of these functionalities while emphasizing ease-of-use. We have also confirmed that the content generated for resumes adheres to the benchmarks of high-quality standards. As future work, we aim to carry out usability testing with real students to further evaluate the application's utility in educational environments.

articleTitle: Driver Drowsiness Detection System Using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: Technology has advanced quickly to enhance the quality of human life. Bicycles were the primary means of transportation during the early 1900s. It's impossible to envision living without a car in the modern day. Although it offers many benefits, there are undoubtedly some life-threatening drawbacks. The chance of an accident increases when a motorist is fatigued, threatening both their own life and the lives of other drivers. Therefore, by identifying the driver's mouth and eye regions and developing a “Driver Drowsiness Detection System,” this paper aims to address the serious problem of drowsiness and weariness. Drowsiness is a state between the alertness and tiredness which result in losing focus and leads to accidents. To solve this problem, this system is designed using Artificial Intelligence. The system for detecting exhaustion included yawn detection and EAR (Eye Aspect Ratio), which were later combined with the Convolutional Neural Network model to increase the efficacy of the drowsiness detection model. This paper discussed various AI techniques like Machine Learning, Haar Cascade Classifier, and OpenCV and concludes that this system can detect driver drowsiness using AI and reduce the risk of accidents.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Various Machine Learning Algorithms for Handwritten Digit Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: One of the most fundamental uses of machine learning is the identification of handwritten digits. There has been a lot of compelling research in this field. Since everyone has different handwriting, it becomes very important for the algorithm to recognize all styles and ways of writing. With the advancement in science and technology, digitization of all forms of documents has become prominent. Since there are still many documents that are yet to be digitized, these applications come in handy. MNIST and SKLearn load_digits datasets are prominent for the recognition process and they have a large set of data points. Many Algorithms are developed over the years that are capable of performing recognition of digits. The accuracy and performance metrics of the methods Support Vector Machine (SVM), Random Forest, Gaussian Naive Bayes, and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) are analyzed in this study.

articleTitle: SecAP: Security Analysis of the Artificial Pancreas
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: The artificial pancreas system is a recent development to assist patients with type 1 diabetes controlling their blood glucose levels. It involves several medical devices that use wireless protocols for communication and thus are vulnerable to cyber attacks. This paper focuses on replay and denial-of-service attacks because of their commonality and potentially significant impact on the patient's health. These attacks were modeled and implemented on the GlucoSym Simulator, a program used to develop safer and more accurate AP control algorithms. The effects of each attack on the patient's glucose and insulin dose levels were observed and recorded. Observations of events of hyperglycemia and hypoglycemia over the course of the simulation were used to identify the ideal time for an attacker to cause the most harm to the patient. Finally, a detection method for these attacks is proposed to alert the AP user that corrective actions need to be taken in the event of an attack.

articleTitle: Autonomous Vehicle Along with Surrounding Agent's Path Prediction Using CNN-Based Models
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)

authors.preferredName: R V B S Prasanth Kumar

abstract: In the modern era, Autonomous Vehicles (AVs) are pivotal within the transportation system, presenting notable engineering challenges in the development of self-driving systems, particularly in agent detection such as pedestrians, surrounding vehicles, traffic lights, bicycles, etc. The dataset utilized comprises level 5 data, encompassing three key tables: scenes, time frames, and traffic agents. Specifically, the traffic agent table contains Zarr compressed files providing information about aerial maps, velocities, and coordinates of agents. The primary objective of this paper revolves around constructing a Convolution Neural Network (CNN) model to discern the motion trajectories of agents in relation to the AV, a demanding and high-priority task in building an advanced self-driving system. To predict these motion trajectories, baseline CNN models like ResNet34 and ResNet50 were employed, compared to determine the optimal model. The results indicate a significant enhancement in Negative Multi Log Likelihood when compared with non-frozen ResNet models. Our future research aims to establish a pipeline for object classification around AV and implement Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) on noise data to project future trajectories.

articleTitle: Ensuring Trustworthy Machine Learning: Ethical Foundations, Robust Algorithms, and Responsible Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Intelligent Systems (ICCCIS)
abstract: Intrusion detection, a pivotal facet of securing digital environments, intersects with the proliferation of machine learning (ML) technologies, which have driven transformative advancements across industries. This research paper systematically investigates the multifaceted challenges and solutions within this critical domain, weaving together ethical foundations, robust algorithms, responsible applications, and intrusion detection. Commencing with a comprehensive exploration of intrusion detection's paramount importance in safeguarding digital realms, we delve into the ethical underpinnings of ML, meticulously analyzing facets such as transparency, fairness, and bias mitigation within the context of intrusion detection. Significantly, this study places a strong emphasis on the methodology adopted for intrusion detection, highlighting its robustness and effectiveness in addressing these ethical challenges.
